title: Stop a stale discovery grant from overwriting a revocation

source.ref: Review of the Codex AI coaching overhaul, 2026-10-26

detail: setSpaceDiscoveryConsent read the stored consent, built a new one and upserted it, so two quick toggles could interleave and a grant computed before a revoke could land after it. The write now carries the consent id the action read and lands only if the stored consent is still that one (or still none, for a first grant); a lost race returns the 'changed while you were saving' error. No migration: the guard is a conditional update on the existing jsonb column. Owner go-ahead: Daniel, 'update the discovery consent pins', 2026-10-26 (action test updated for the extra argument).

verify.note: Exits 0 once the consent write is guarded by the id the action read.
